description: Understand website traffic, visitor sources and popular pages with Savri. Optional, brief start help answers one question at a time; technical setup help is available when requested.

interface.longDescription: Ask naturally about one or several authorized websites using traffic, goals and connected Google and Bing reports. Optional start help gives a short introduction and one relevant next step. Existing received visits lead to reports; code and technical installation help appear only when requested. Review affiliate commission with its matching quality or request alert previews. Each user keeps their own account connection.
defaultPrompt: How do people find my website, which contact goals are recorded, and what should I improve first?
Compare my selected websites over 30 completed days, with available Google, Bing and Savri data.
Which pages have affiliate clicks and approved commission, and where is evidence missing?
